payload.description: The allocation scheme at the address the council's own report links to. Paragraph 2 of the report to Cabinet names the current scheme as a hyperlink; that link goes to a page which, when we followed it on 7 September 2026, refused us with “Access denied”. The scheme is readable at the address used throughout this page, so nothing is lost — but a council report pointing residents at a page they cannot open is worth recording.
